description: This PHP source file manages the account settings page for geotargeting in the Revive Adserver platform. It handles form submissions to update geotargeting settings, displays the settings form with available options, and includes security and page rendering logic.

classes.description: Models the page header for admin UI pages.

classes.name: OX_Component
classes.description: Represents components used in the admin interface, such as geotargeting options.

methods.description: Processes submitted form data to update settings.

methods.description: Retrieves preferences for a specific settings section.

methods.description: Redirects the user to another page.
